reviews.review: Fun, Rouge-like FPS, good mechanics, Combat is great, Bosses are good. Really great replay value with all the different classes and builds you can choose. One Time trail could be easier but that's the only negative point in the game in my opinion.

One of the most fun rougelikes I have ever played. The movement tech, the unlocks, the weapons, the music, the sound design, the ubeat comic artstyle; it all works together to bring abut an incredible experience. And updates only make it better; the endless update brought about a run where I was firing so fast, the sound effects litterally could not keep up with the animations.

I only have one wish/minor problem, and that is the shooting range/weapon testing room needs is to be revamped. 
Once in the late game, you can unlock the weapons range by saving a imprisoned robot npc. This npc being a  cashier who runs an underground bunker diner with built in gun range, because this game is great. 
Being able to test out certain weapon combinations, affixes, addons, and quality levels is a very fun idea: master craft the ultimate weapon, just for the fun of it! See what you can make. Theres even a shooting gallery minigame like RE4 or every county fair ever.
However, as of the Endless update, the system of weapon testing is limited. 
1. You can upgrade a weapon's quality, but not its level
2. You cant upgrade a weapon to the orange quality, only purple
3. The only way to choose affixes is to roll for it
4. Addons can only be rolled for, not chosen.
5. You cant select perfume affixes. 
6. You cannot increase your player level and select perks for true chaos.
7. Items with their special effects are unable to be chosen, so you really cant have true chaos.

I think if the shooting gallery was truly a creative mode outside of normal gameplay, but limiting us to creating weapons that can actually be rolled for, it would be way more enjoyable. Let us create chaos! I want a gorilla blaster that does all three element damage, fires a shotgun blast every so often, and when I right click I fire faster than the speed of light.
robots killing other robots???? with awesome guns????? hell yeah...
